title.value: Neural Causal Structure Discovery from Interventions
title.justification: The paper introduces a novel framework using neural networks for causal structure discovery utilizing interventional data.
title.quote: We propose a general framework based on neural networks to develop models that incorporate both observational and interventional data.

extractions.description: The paper proposes a novel neural-network-based method for causal discovery, called Structure Discovery from Interventions (SDI). This method integrates both observational and interventional data to discover causal structures in Bayesian networks. The paper highlights SDI's ability to handle unknown interventions and partially-known graph structures, proving its efficacy in graph recovery tasks with synthetic and naturalistic data.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not directly address any eco-responsible category or application. Its focus is on the development of a causal discovery method using neural networks.
primary_category.quote: We propose a novel neural network based causal discovery algorithm sdi, which leverages both observational and interventional data.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not explore eco-responsible topics or applications within its research scope. It is primarily centered on causal discovery within machine learning.
secondary_categories.quote: Our proposed method Structure Discovery from Interventions (sdi) is among the first causal discovery methods based on neural networks utilizing both observational and interventional data.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's content does not correlate with any specific eco-responsible sub-category. It is fundamentally about causal inference and methodology advancements in machine learning.
primary_sub_category.quote: Our model outperforms previous methods on both synthetic and naturalistic Causal Bayesian Networks (CBNs).

secondary_sub_categories.justification: As the paper is not focused on eco-responsible applications or topics, it does not align with any secondary eco-responsible sub-categories.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: The recovery of the underlying structural causal graph from observational and interventional data is a fundamental problem (Pearl, 1995; 2009; Spirtes et al., 2000).
